title: Secure and transparent energy management using blockchain and machine learning anomaly detection: A case study of the Ausgrid dataset
summary: Blockchain used to make energy exchange records auditable, with machine-learning anomaly detection over the consumption data on top; evaluated against the Ausgrid smart-meter dataset.

title: Dual verification-based multimodal approach for reliable pothole and speed bump detection on embedded system
summary: Road-surface hazard detection running on an embedded target, where two sensing modalities have to agree before a detection is reported — the check that keeps a single noisy channel from raising it alone.
